Origin and meaning

Sarah is a Hebrew name meaning “princess”.

About the name Sarah

In the Bible, Sarah was the wife of Abraham and mother of Isaac.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Sarah carries the meaning “princess” and looks striking in brush strokes.
